snippet.title: A look at steams 4th worst reviewed Metroidvania title - NIHILSEARCH
snippet.description:
I honestly don't know why I want to defend this one so much. I go into it a lot near the end of the video but its lacking polish for sure but it isn't that bad nor is it deserving of such negative reviews.

Here is fireb0rn's video that inspired me to play this one in the first place: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QSInPRQXSBU&t=2s

and here is the link to the store page for the game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1622640/Nihilsearch/


Follow my twitter for updates: https://twitter.com/Bb_McKjaminn
Thanks for watching! Feel free to like and all the other gooey good stuff.
